gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian stands tall and full-bodied, plain sans through and through. Galaxy is at its best as a loose, wire-thin display line that floats across the space, while the body is best at filling lines with generous, inviting rounds.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Tubing-like lines, loose and cosmic, carry Galaxy across the top while Noto Sans Avestan follows with a crisp, tall x-height. Shrink the heading and its wiry strokes thin out fast.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Galaxy's strokes never swell or thin, curves matching stems exactly. Noto Sans Balinese below keeps short ascenders and a little room inside every curve, so the sans-serif text sits quietly under that wide-spaced, commanding display line.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Galaxy draws every letter like bent wire, one thickness from end to end, loose and dense. Noto Sans Bamum then arrives with open counters and curves that stop short of turning inward, which feels softer and more spacious beside it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Cosmic wire lettering up top, with crossbars as thick as the stems, then a body with a huge midsection. Noto Sans Bassa Vah keeps that open-jawed c, so a long stretch of it reads steady and generous.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-batak: Noto Sans Batak reads big and friendly, its towering x-height and wide-open e never looking squeezed. Galaxy adds its constant-line, blueprint feel above, though a shrunken heading would lose some of that commanding presence.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Strokes like bent paperclips, loose and cosmic, make Galaxy feel like a constellation drawn in wire. Noto Sans Bengali brings capitals barely above lowercase and open mouths; try it at generous size beside the heading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Galaxy is all joined-up wire, no thinning where strokes meet. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki's swollen lowercase and readable apertures give it a sturdy, plain sans partner, and that tension is the pair's real pull.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads high-lined and open-ended, every curve left slightly unfinished. Galaxy's pen never shifts pressure or angle, and that stubborn consistency against the body's looser curves is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Noto Sans Buginese leaves its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs. Galaxy hangs above it, each letter bent from one wire and spaced loosely, while the short-ascender body keeps the page grounded.
